user.title: Canvas Display
user.description: Enter the URL of the Canvas Display server running on this device (e.g. http://192.168.1.x:3100). Add one entry per device. For Core mode, enter the Canvas Core URL (e.g. https://192.168.1.108:3100) and tick 'Core mode' to expose every registered edge device as a media player.

data.core_mode: Core mode (one media player per edge device)

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Canvas Display server. Check the URL and ensure it is running.
